responsibility: This is the primary target configuration header for the m68k backend. It defines preprocessor builtins, assembler and linker spec fragments, register naming and operand-printing macros, exception-handling data format choices, assembly output conventions, target enums and exported globals, and a large set of ABI, data-layout, and backend macros that connect GCC’s generic infrastructure to the Motorola 680x0/ColdFire implementation. In contrast to m68k.cc’s executable logic, this file provides the compile-time macro interface and target-wide constants used across the backend.
same_name_distinction: Provides the compile-time target definition layer for the m68k stem: preprocessor builtins, asm/link spec macros, assembly-output conventions, exported enums, and declarations shared across the backend. Unlike m68k.cc it contains interface macros and declarations rather than hook implementations, unlike m68k.md it is not the RTL pattern file, and unlike m68k.opt it does not define user option records.
